notes: From VC3D: the selected ink detection is the map; its reverse-depth control and the segment's labels come from the segment's ink detection records (role or artifact type), then from villa's file names (MAP_reverse, SEG_inklabels.zarr, SEG_supervision_mask.zarr). A run without the control is not a pass.

prediction.label: the ink map on the segment's 9 um surface grid

window.label: only this box of the map (VC3D's focus region on the segment's canvas)

bootstrap.help: block-bootstrap draws for a 95 % interval (300 is plenty; 0 for none)

inner.help: pixels left out at every edge

vc3d.label: AUC of the selected ink map against the segment's labels

facts.title: auc
facts.tagline: score an ink map against a segment's published labels
facts.not_a_pass: A forward AUC without its control; a map less than 0.10 above its control; a ranking whose `--compare` interval includes 0; any score on a segment the model trained on.
facts.never: Call an AUC a reading or say letters were found; call a score on w035, or on w045 for `ink_9um` and its fine-tunes, a generalization result.
